name: last-push
description: When this project was last committed and pushed, in one line under the Claude Code prompt: unpushed commits, uncommitted files, staleness colour and a reminder

mode.title: Display
mode.description: full: the whole line · compact: symbols only · off: hidden

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: A toast when commits sit unpushed, or files uncommitted, longer than the stale time — once per state

remindAfter.title: Stale after (hours)
remindAfter.description: Hours until waiting work turns red and the reminder fires; 0 turns both off
